observer_correction: Legacy RegFull attributes capacity-check failures to ROB/LSQ head stall reasons and undercounts physical-capacity backpressure. Use observer schema >=2 for new experiments.
measurement: same checkpoint, warmup 1M instructions, measure 1M instructions

thresholds.pressure: standalone capacity blocked cycles >=1% of total cycles
thresholds.performance: IPC loss >1% and >5% versus the same-slice default configuration

limits: selected top-weight slice per workload, not full SPEC; simulator capacity only, no area or clock modeling
